def choose_move(observation):
    agent_state = observation.get('agent', {})
    position = agent_state.get('position', (0, 0))
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    enemies = observation.get('enemies', [])
    territory = observation.get('territory', {})
    border = territory.get('border', [])

    def get_closest(targets):
        if targets:
            return min(targets, key=lambda t: abs(t[0]-position[0]) + abs(t[1]-position[1]))
        else:
            return None

    resource_target = get_closest(resources)
    enemy_target = get_closest(enemies)
    territory_target = get_closest(border)

    # Choose priority: resource > enemy > territory
    target = resource_target or enemy_target or territory_target

    if target:
        dx = (target[0] - position[0])
        dy = (target[1] - position[1])
        dx = (dx > 0) - (dx < 0)
        dy = (dy > 0) - (dy < 0)
        return [dx, dy]
    else:
        return [0, 0]
